title: Kafka 발행 패턴 실측 런북 (Publish-Pattern Benchmark)
summary: Runbook comparing three payment.cancelled publish modes (INLINE / INLINE_ASYNC / OUTBOX) on an AWS rig for throughput, latency, and failure behavior.
notes: Benchmark/experiment runbook: prose + procedural bash steps + comparison methodology. No ADR status/decision/consequences, no user stories/acceptance criteria, no API/schema contract. Describes an experiment design rather than mandating a requirement → DOC (context). Medium confidence: technical detail is high but it documents a measurement procedure, not a spec or decision.
